visual_principles.name: Digital Wilderness
visual_principles.description: Disciplined engineering meets organic emergence. Architectural precision against cultivated texture. The brand sits at the seam where rigor and growth meet — neither clinical nor lush, but held together.

visual_principles.name: Editorial-documentary photography
visual_principles.description: Real prototyping spaces, not staged studios. Tactile materials. Working environments. Evidence sits next to every claim. Photography looks like feature stories in a design or technology publication, not startup marketing.

visual_principles.name: Material honesty
visual_principles.description: Surfaces read as themselves: matte paper has grain, brushed aluminum has direction, weathered stone has texture, living moss is alive. No glossy plastic, no stock gradients, no fake texture. The materials carry the meaning.

visual_principles.name: Restraint over excess
visual_principles.description: Generous negative space, limited labels, clear modular grids. The brand speaks quietly. Atmosphere comes from phrasing and image choice, not volume. Premium restraint, not loud luxury.

visual_principles.name: Bento-grid composition
visual_principles.description: Editorial layouts use a 6-module bento structure: hero, social, palette, typography specimen, logo block, brand DNA. Each module earns its place. The grid is structural, not decorative.

visual_principles.name: Material expressions of the logo
visual_principles.description: The tree mark translates across premium materials — dark metal, polished chrome, embossed glass, wax seal, holo-vinyl, concrete-botanical installation — without ever being replaced. Material variations are art-direction references, not replacement marks.

style.lighting: Soft architectural daylight with dramatic single-source side lighting. Screen glow accents from active displays. Warm Energetic Orange highlights on prototype surfaces.
style.composition: Rule of thirds with text-safe zones for hero/lifestyle. Editorial framing. Knolling for product shots. Wide cinematic for establishing shots.
style.color_treatment: Branded tint — Deep Quantum Blue (#1A237E) shadows, Teal (#00897B) accent tones, Mindful Gray (#37474F) neutrals. Energetic Orange (#F57C00) ignition. Growth Light (#B8E986) for organic signals.
style.subject_focus: Founders and operators in prototyping spaces — not stock photo models. System artifacts as the subject matter: screens showing delivery dashboards, hand-drawn requirement sketches on matte paper, working prototypes on brushed aluminum.
style.mood: Premium, sophisticated, real. The feeling of a serious design studio that cares about craft. Working environments, not staged sets.
style.context: Editorial-documentary. The kind of imagery that appears in design publications (Fast Company, Wired, Awwwards) as feature stories, not marketing pages.

references: Editorial feature photography from Fast Company and Wired founder profiles
Architecture photography from Brutalist and Contemporary museum installations
Studio documentation photography from Pentagram and IDEO project archives
Industrial design photography from Dezeen and Wallpaper*
photography.prompt_template: Editorial [lifestyle/product/hero] photography for Thoughtseed — a founder-led systems studio. [Subject: founder in prototyping space]. [Setting: real workspace, not staged]. [Lighting: soft architectural daylight with Teal screen accents]. [Color palette: Deep Quantum Blue shadows, Teal accents, Energetic Orange highlights]. [Style: editorial-documentary, high resolution, film grain]. [Aspect ratio: 16:9 for hero, 4:3 for product, 9:16 for stories].

style.type: geometric systems diagrams blended with organic signal patterns
style.complexity: medium — diagrams are legible, not overworked
style.color_approach: primary palette with restrained accents — no rainbow gradients

illustration.prompt_template: Geometric systems diagram for Thoughtseed — a founder-led systems studio. [Subject: e.g., delivery loop, requirement architecture, handoff system]. [Style: clean line art, technical diagram aesthetic]. [Color palette: Deep Quantum Blue + Teal + Mindful Gray, with Energetic Orange ignition on critical paths]. [Background: white or light neutral]. [Tone: editorial, calm, legible]. High resolution, vector-clean.

iconography.stroke_weight: consistent, medium — uniform line weight across all icons
categories: service_modules (Requirement Architecture, Product & Interface Systems, Handoff & Decision Systems)

patterns.type: geometric systems diagrams blended with organic signal patterns; tessellating
patterns.prompt_template: Tessellating geometric pattern for Thoughtseed — a founder-led systems studio. [Subject: e.g., delivery loop motif, requirement diagram as tile]. [Color: Deep Quantum Blue base with Teal accents, OR Mindful Gray base with Teal/Growth Light accents]. [Style: editorial, geometric, clean]. [Scale: tileable, seamless edges]. High resolution.

do: Use editorial-documentary photography for hero, lifestyle, and product shots
Anchor compositions with Deep Quantum Blue shadows and Teal accents
Apply bento-grid structure to brand overview and identity compositions
Translate the tree mark across premium materials as art direction
Use generous negative space and restrained typography
Pair every claim with the artifact that proves it
Show real prototyping spaces with working artifacts
Maintain material honesty — surfaces read as themselves
dont: Don't use empty futurism (chrome, glow, sterile surfaces)
Don't use mystical fog or mystical atmosphere
Don't bake text into hero imagery — render typography separately
Don't name the internal methodology or its metaphors in public copy
Don't use 'conscious/consciousness' framing in public copy
Don't use 'full-service agency' framing — the studio is scoped, scoped, scoped
